<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram name="W02 Accessibility" id="0"> <mxGraphModel dx="-914" dy="-240" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1780" pageHeight="960" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=18;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#333333;" value="W02 — Accessibility remediation copilot: the only plan in six folders with lawsuits already filed" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="1400" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="urg" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="WHY THIS IS THE MOST URGENT ITEM

28 Jun 2025 EAA in force across the EU
Jul 2025 FRANCE issues formal legal notices
 to major retailers
Oct 2025 SWEDEN launches market surveillance
Nov 2025 FIRST EAA LAWSUITS FILED
 (French Commercial Court)
ongoing Dutch ACM actively enforcing

Scope: any business selling online to EU consumers,
REGARDLESS OF WHERE THE COMPANY IS LOCATED,
above 10 employees and €2M.
Standard: EN 301 549 / WCAG 2.1 Level AA minimum.
Penalties: up to €500,000 plus daily penalties.
Legacy contracts: comply by 28 Jun 2027." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="320" width="400" x="40" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="limit" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="THE HONEST LIMIT, STATED FIRST

Automated tools catch roughly A THIRD of WCAG issues.

Keyboard traps · focus order · meaningful alt text ·
screen-reader flow · error recovery
→ need MANUAL testing with assistive technology.

So this is a remediation COPILOT, not an auto-fixer.
It finds, prioritises, drafts and proves the fix.
A human reviews. A human tests with a screen reader.

The French lawsuits will not be won with a
Lighthouse score." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="400" x="40" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pipe" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="CI pipeline (Harness, already live at :3080)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="610" width="620" x="490" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="SCAN — three engines, because they catch different things
axe-core (Deque, MPL-2.0) the de-facto WCAG rule engine
Pa11y (LGPL-3.0) CI-friendly runner
Lighthouse (Apache-2.0) score + regression
IBM Equal Access (Apache) second opinion, different rules
driven through the journeys by Playwright" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="98" width="580" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" value="DEDUPE + MAP to WCAG 2.1 AA criteria and EN 301 549 clauses" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="580" x="20" y="152" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="PRIORITISE BY JOURNEY, NOT BY COUNT
checkout &gt; cart &gt; PDP &gt; search &gt; listing &gt; marketing
an inaccessible checkout is a blocked sale;
an inaccessible footer is not" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="580" x="20" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="COMPONENT ATTRIBUTION — the Angular advantage
violations cluster in COMPONENTS, not pages.
Fix one shared &lt;app-form-field&gt; → hundreds of page-level
violations disappear. Finding the component behind the
violations is exactly what a model is good at and a scanner is not." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="84" width="580" x="20" y="280" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p5" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="AI REMEDIATION DRAFT (tier 0 local — no customer data involved)
in: violating DOM fragment + component source + WCAG criterion
out: proposed Angular template/TS patch + rationale + criterion
VALIDATOR: patch parses · component compiles ·
 re-scan clears it · NO NEW violations" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="88" width="580" x="20" y="374" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p6" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="DEVELOPER REVIEW — always. DRAFT PR, NEVER AUTO-MERGE." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="38" width="580" x="20" y="472" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p7" parent="pipe" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" value="RE-SCAN in CI → REGRESSION GATE
a merged PR may not increase violations on the priority journeys" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="580" x="20" y="520" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="add" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#faf7fc;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#6b4c85;" value="What the AI adds over a plain scanner" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="300" width="580" x="1160" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a1" parent="add" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="scanner: a list of DOM violations
copilot: THE COMPONENT responsible + the blast radius" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="540" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a2" parent="add" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="scanner: a WCAG criterion ID
copilot: a DRAFTED PATCH in our Angular idiom" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="540" x="20" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a3" parent="add" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="scanner: pass / fail
copilot: JOURNEY-WEIGHTED priority — checkout first" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="540" x="20" y="156" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a4" parent="add" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="scanner: nothing on alt text
copilot: DRAFT ALT TEXT from the product image + I05's cleaned
 attributes, for bulk human approval
 ⚠ NEVER auto-publish — wrong alt text actively misleads
 a screen-reader user. Worse than none." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="76" width="540" x="20" y="212" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="out" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="Outputs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="280" width="580" x="1160" y="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o1" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="ACCESSIBILITY STATEMENT — generated from the current state,
versioned, published. The EAA requires one, and it must be TRUTHFUL." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="56" width="540" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o2" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="MANUAL-TESTING CHECKLIST for the two thirds automation cannot
catch — with a NAMED OWNER and a SCHEDULE.
Say out loud that this exists." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="62" width="540" x="20" y="110" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o3" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="Bulk alt-text review through the EXISTING SKU audit approval gate
(N-02 / I05) — no new workflow" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="540" x="20" y="182" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o4" parent="out" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="⚠ W04's consumer DPP passport page must be built accessible
 FROM DAY ONE — retrofitting is a self-inflicted wound" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="26" width="540" x="20" y="242" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="foot" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;dashed=1;" value="~13 dev-days — the cheapest plan in this folder, aimed at the only regulation here that has already produced litigation, on a frontend we already own (ecommerce-front-end, Angular SSR).
Step 1 alone — a baseline scan across the six key journeys — is one day and worth doing regardless of the contest, because it sizes everything else.
⚠ axe-core is MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft) and Pa11y is LGPL-3.0. Use them as CI tools; read the licences before vendoring modified files. Both belong in the register." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="1700" x="40" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="urg" div.div:
WHY THIS IS THE MOST URGENT ITEM
28 Jun 2025 EAA in force across the EU
Jul 2025 FRANCE issues formal legal notices
to major retailers
Oct 2025 SWEDEN launches market surveillance
Nov 2025 FIRST EAA LAWSUITS FILED
(French Commercial Court)
ongoing Dutch ACM actively enforcing
Scope: any business selling online to EU consumers,
REGARDLESS OF WHERE THE COMPANY IS LOCATED,
above 10 employees and €2M.
Standard: EN 301 549 / WCAG 2.1 Level AA minimum.
Penalties: up to €500,000 plus daily penalties.
Legacy contracts: comply by 28 Jun 2027.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 253, 245), rgb(22, 20, 14)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 388px; height: 1px; padding-top: 435px; margin-left: 12px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
THE HONEST LIMIT, STATED FIRST
Automated tools catch roughly A THIRD of WCAG issues.
Keyboard traps · focus order · meaningful alt text ·
screen-reader flow · error recovery
→ need MANUAL testing with assistive technology.
So this is a remediation COPILOT, not an auto-fixer.
It finds, prioritises, drafts and proves the fix.
A human reviews. A human tests with a screen reader.
The French lawsuits will not be won with a
Lighthouse score.

div.div:
SCAN — three engines, because they catch different things
axe-core (Deque, MPL-2.0) the de-facto WCAG rule engine
Pa11y (LGPL-3.0) CI-friendly runner
Lighthouse (Apache-2.0) score + regression
IBM Equal Access (Apache) second opinion, different rules
driven through the journeys by Playwright

div.div:
~13 dev-days — the cheapest plan in this folder, aimed at the only regulation here that has already produced litigation, on a frontend we already own (ecommerce-front-end, Angular SSR).
Step 1 alone — a baseline scan across the six key journeys — is one day and worth doing regardless of the contest, because it sizes everything else.
⚠ axe-core is MPL-2.0 (file-level copyleft) and Pa11y is LGPL-3.0. Use them as CI tools; read the licences before vendoring modified files. Both belong in the register.
